cards.card_text: He also warns Israel not to turn to mediums or spiritists.
cards.verse_text: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them.
cards.snippet: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them.

cards.card_text: What does God say happens to people who seek out mediums and spiritists?
cards.verse_text: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them.
cards.snippet: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD names mediums and spiritists.
cards.verse_text: Whoever turns to mediums or spiritists to prostitute himself with them, I will also set My face against that person and cut him off from his people.
cards.snippet: Whoever turns to mediums or spiritists to prostitute himself with them, I will also set My face against…

cards.card_text: One last law closes it out, and it's about mediums and spiritists themselves.
cards.verse_text: A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death.
cards.snippet: A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death.

cards.card_text: The LORD says a man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must be ___.
cards.verse_text: A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death.
cards.snippet: A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death.

cards.card_text: Saul had removed the mediums and spiritists from the land, and somebody MISSED A SPOT?
cards.verse_text: And Saul had removed the mediums and spiritists from the land.
cards.snippet: And Saul had removed the mediums and spiritists from the land.

cards.card_text: Manasseh practices sorcery and divination, and he consults ___ and spiritists.
cards.verse_text: He sacrificed his own son in the fire, practiced sorcery and divination, and consulted mediums and spiritists.
cards.snippet: …son in the fire, practiced sorcery and divination, and consulted mediums and spiritists.

cards.card_text: Through all of this, Manasseh stays far away from sorcery, mediums and spiritists.
cards.verse_text: He practiced sorcery, divination, and witchcraft, and consulted mediums and spiritists.
cards.snippet: He practiced sorcery, divination, and witchcraft, and consulted mediums and spiritists.

cards.card_text: Then Isaiah brings up a moment when men say to consult mediums and spiritists, the ones who whisper and mutter.
cards.verse_text: When men tell you to consult mediums and spiritists who whisper and mutter, shouldn’t a people consult their God instead?
cards.snippet: When men tell you to consult mediums and spiritists who whisper and mutter, shouldn’t a people consult their God instead?
